data.title: Network Problem
data.description:
These common issues however can be a network receptor hardware glitch of the iPhone 6. To resolve these Apple recommends its iPhone 6 users some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes as a home remedy, such as:

  • Toggle Airplane Mode on and off to reset the previous network settings and cache.
  • Remove your sim card and reinstall it again. (requires a restart of the device)
  • Set up the internet for your phone if you’re facing internet issues through the network for the first time. To set up go to Settings > Mobile Data > Mobile Data Network

then:

  • Insert APN (Access Point Name) provided by your carrier
  • Insert Username (provided by your carrier)
  • Insert Password (provided by your carrier)
  • Save the settings by pressing the left arrow at the top.
  • Make sure your Data connection is on after setting up the network before you access the internet.
  • Install carrier update for your iPhone (Check-in Settings > General > About)
  • Restart your iPhone
  • Soft reset your iPhone

data.title: No Modem Firmware
data.description:
You may face a similar kind of problem with your iPhone 6 Plus. It usually happens after a faulty or uncompleted update where you might see that:

There’s no network bar available at the top of the display. Restarting or reinstalling the SIM card doesn’t help. There is always “Searching” shown on the network bar

There are no Cellular connections available for your phone. You can’t turn on, discover, or connect to available wireless Hotspot networks available near you through your iPhone 6 Plus

You can’t connect to your Bluetooth devices like Apple Watch, Bluetooth headphones, and stereo speakers through your phone. It appears that you cannot connect to anything wireless through your iPhone 6 Plus

If you are facing this issue go to Settings > General > About and see if you find information regarding IMEI, Bluetooth location, Modem Firmware, etc. If there is nothing there then you have an issue with the modem firmware. There are no DIY fixes available for this issue. You are going to be needed to take your iPhone 6 Plus to an expert repair technician to resolve the “No modem firmware” issue.

data.title: Wifi Issue
data.description:
Other issues like high ping or latency have often been reported by the users of the phone. The most common reported iPhone 6 Plus Wi-Fi issues are...

  • Wi-Fi gets disconnected on iPhone 6 Plus
  • Wi-Fi stays connected but there is no internet on the receiver
  • Slow Wi-Fi speeds on metered/ non-metered connections on Wi-Fi
  • High Latency/Ping on Wi-Fi connections
  • iPhone fails to connect to Wi-Fi
  • iPhone can’t discover your Wi-Fi connection

These Wi-Fi issues found on iPhone 6 Plus are pretty common issues found on other wireless supported devices too! And does not necessarily indicate that there is something specifically wrong with your iPhone 6 Plus wireless hardware. There are some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes available for your smartphone in this case.

  • Check your wireless router. Unplug it from the power source for 10 minutes and try again and see if the issues have been resolved.
  • Turn your Wi-Fi off for five minutes and try again.
  • Forget and reconnect your Wi-Fi connection.
  • Restore the default network connection ( Reset from here: Settings > General > Reset > Reset Network Connections > * Enter Passcode * > Confirm)
  • Update your iOS to the latest version available.

If none of the solutions mentioned above works to resolve your Wi-Fi issues on your iPhone 6 Plus, you may need to get it checked by a professional technician. data.description:

  • No sound in audio playback
  • Phone stuck in Headphone mode
  • Distorted sound/Low sound on the speakers
  • Audio not working or audio levels low after an update.
  • Ringer Switch not working/ Audio level increases or decreases automatically/ Physical audio level buttons not working.

Now your microphone issue may be caused by any of the one or all 3 microphones not working. There are some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes to try before you come to a decision.

  • Make sure if you use a protective cover for your phone. It doesn’t obstruct any speaker grills or mic holes.
  • Clear the phone to check and make sure there isn’t any debris in there.
  • Try recording your voice in a voice memo to make sure the mic works go to: Settings > Privacy > Microphone and make sure the app is listed there for it to use the microphone.

With 18+ years of experience, 500,000+ devices repaired, and 70+ expert technicians across 4 dedicated branches in Dhaka, iFixit BD repairs every iPhone 6 Plus fault. Apple's first large-screen iPhone — the 5.5-inch Retina HD display, A8 chip, optical image stabilisation, and Touch ID — launched in 2014. What are the common iPhone 6 Plus problems we fix?

Battery completely depleted — replacement is essential

A 10–12 year old lithium-ion cell holds almost no practical charge. iPhone 6 Plus batteries in service today require immediate replacement for any continued use — this is not a question of "when" but "now." iPhone 6 Plus battery replacement

Cracked 5.5-inch LCD screen

The 5.5-inch Retina HD LCD display shows standard LCD damage after cracks — white backlight spots, touch dead zones, and dark bleed patches. Full display assembly replacement restores complete function. iPhone 6 Plus screen replacement

Touch Disease — flickering grey bar and unresponsive touch

The iPhone 6 Plus has a known board-level fault called Touch Disease. A design weakness in the touch IC solder joints on the logic board causes a flickering grey bar to appear at the top of the screen, followed by complete touch failure. This is not a screen fault — it is a logic board fault requiring micro-soldering re-work to fix. iFixit BD's board-level lab addresses Touch Disease directly. iPhone 6 Plus Touch Disease repair

Touch ID home button not working

The physical home button and Touch ID sensor wear after 10+ years of use. Mechanical failure, touch sensor degradation, and broken pairing from prior repairs all cause Touch ID failure. iFixit BD restores Touch ID function where the board-level pairing is intact. iPhone 6 Plus home button / Touch ID repair

Lightning port completely worn after 10 years

A decade of daily cable connections has worn the Lightning port pins past usability. Port cleaning alone cannot restore function at this age — flex cable replacement is required. iPhone 6 Plus charging issues

Step 1 — Free diagnosis. Bring your iPhone 6 Plus to any iFixit BD branch. Fault identified, written quote at no cost.

Step 2 — Report and fixed price. Written fault report, fixed price, A-grade and Original side by side.
